expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.tilanne==='saippua' && S.d===200 && S.lam===550 && S.n===1.33 && S.shifts===1 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: soap film, d = 200 nm, λ = 550 nm, one shift (must run before any setup)

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); const S=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select'); return R.length===2 && S.length===1 && S[0].options.length===2 && R[0].min==='0' && R[0].max==='1000' && R[0].step==='1' && R[1].min==='400' && R[1].max==='700' && R[1].step==='1' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: one select (two situations), sliders d 0–1000 nm by 1 and λ 400–700 nm by 1

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='d,lam,tilanne' && P.d.unit==='nm' && P.lam.unit==='nm' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares tilanne, d (nm) and lam (nm)
